verdict.rationale: Amplitude ships an official MCP server for bringing analytics context into AI tools, and the Wizard CLI produces a first dashboard from one terminal command. However, the Dashboard REST API is documented only as returning dashboard graph data in JSON, and the MCP server is positioned as giving answers rather than configuring dashboards. Nothing shows an agent creating a custom dashboard of chosen metrics end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP endpoints to create charts and dashboards, an agent-driven example of building a key-metrics dashboard, independent hands-on corroboration.
